notes.title: Fixed bugs of game starting
notes.content:
Thank you all who have bought and focused this game. 
I'm so sorry I haven't answered your questions and fixed bugs immediately,  because my network was restricted to access 'community' before, so I couldn't see comments. Also it's my first time released a game on Steam, I knew less about Steam functions, I'll learn more about it. Now I fixed some bugs frequently mentioned, hope you will enjoy the game!
